svg.title: C19-M01-F2: Contents of a complete RoE
svg.desc: Five groups of required RoE contents.
svg.text: C19-M01-F2 Contents of a complete RoE
AUTHORISATION : authorising party + signed agreement + window
SCOPE : in-scope systems ; explicit out-of-scope (prod, third parties)
SAFETY : isolation ; no destruction ; no real data ; simulation-only
CONTROL : stop conditions ; deconfliction (operator tags) ; contacts
HANDLING : encrypted storage ; retention ; reporting (exec + technical)
Figure C19-M01-F2. The required contents of a Rules of Engagement [C19-M01-R1].
